scope: Startup-required process memory prerequisites; source ownership audit only, no memory backend implementation or runtime support

sourceReview.scope: Source-only owning-layer memory review; no backend implementation, build or runtime proof
findings: Current State.externalBytes only counts explicit ExternalMemoryAccounter users; native BackingStore and ordinary engine buffers are not a complete unified owner account
Original NodeArrayBufferAllocator tracks actual Allocate/Free/RegisterPointer/UnregisterPointer lifetime, not arbitrary buffer view lengths
SM ClassInfo combines ordinary object element storage with ArrayBuffer storage in objectsMallocHeapElementsNormal; cannot equate it to arrayBuffers
SM external buffers are deliberately omitted from standard object memory reporting because their owner must account them
Existing retained native contents may outlive JavaScript detach; a live-object traversal alone would miss those surviving allocations
SharedArrayBuffer standard report apportions byteLength/max among refcount holders; this is distinct from origin-allocator ownership
Raw GC allocation bytes are not RSS or a complete JavaScript/native buffer total
SM CollectRuntimeStats finishes ongoing GC and helper tasks, traverses whole heap and can fail allocation; mapping its result into a void-style HeapStatistics API requires explicit failure handling
malloc_usable_size exists in actual musl mallocng/oldmalloc; current SpiderMonkey recipe disables jemalloc. No zero-returning size callback should be used.
remaining: Design actual allocation-lifetime counters across engine ordinary/shared/native/retained/transferred backings before reporting arrayBuffers/external memory
Define owning-engine heap categories using genuine SM measurements rather than copying V8 values or equating unrelated counters
Preserve worker origin ownership, detach/resize/transfer/GC release, shared deduplication and failure semantics
Kernel rusage/sysinfo gaps remain independent; no kernel/libc or ABI change made

measurementContract.heapTotal: Actual owning-engine heap capacity; must account engine allocation categories rather than alias unrelated GC/linear-memory counters
measurementContract.heapUsed: Actual occupied owning-engine heap with explicit inclusion/exclusion of out-of-line data; cannot silently substitute allocated arena capacity
measurementContract.external: Complete actual native allocations associated with JS ownership, including supported external strings/backings and their lifetimes; current narrow State.externalBytes alone is insufficient
measurementContract.arrayBuffers: Actual allocator-owned backing allocations across ordinary/shared/retained/transferred lifetimes; avoid counting views or losing storage after detach
measurementContract.rss: Actual guest process resident accounting; GC bytes, Wasm reservation and engine heap are not interchangeable
measurementContract.systemMemory: Guest accounting/constrained limits; existing fixed sysinfo values are not truthful totals

ownershipValidationRequired: ordinary JS ArrayBuffer and typed-array lazy backing allocation
native Buffer/external/adopted allocation registration and deletion
shared-origin ownership and exact de-duplication across realms/workers
detach/native retention, transfer, resizable/growable buffers and final release
accounting survives JS owner collection until actual backing is freed
allocation/resize/copy/finalizer/OOM failure and concurrent counter snapshots
GC/compaction and byte-account balances for all4hosts

layerClassification.engineEmbedding: Incomplete instrumentation and contracts; not a demonstrated SpiderMonkey defect or browser impossibility
layerClassification.libc: Actual musl malloc_usable_size available; no fabricated zero callback
layerClassification.guestKernel: rusage/sysinfo remain recorded implementation gaps; fixes require reporting deferred-build need before proceeding
layerClassification.hosts: No per-host boundary established by this source-only audit; identical-artifact validation needed on Node/Chromium/Firefox/WebKit

dependencyOrder: reconcile allocation owners/producers/consumers and memory categories
implement genuine owning-layer counters or supported engine measurements with honest failure handling
bind native HeapStatistics/allocator/libuv interfaces only to those real owners
validate on all4hosts through original process methods
